title: Preserve the existing pipeline
when: Survey finds deployed app or CI/release files
need: Map the existing app and installed Pack receipts. Existing scripts are evidence to inspect, not permission to reinstall infrastructure. Current executor can dispatch a project-owned GitHub Actions workflow.
surface: Onboard profile “Step 2” through its Pack proposal; flow runner contract lines 287–312.
gap: Onboarding offers no-host projects only merge-only/no-default although the executor supports external-project Actions delivery. Proposed adoption branch needs to separate infrastructure ownership from delivery orchestration.
